problem: The native XLSX picture/rectangle fixture was rejected as out-of-order because the scanner did not count a direct shape as an anchor object. Native lowercase rich-value MIME types were skipped and the graph then rejected. Once admitted, native types metadata exposed a root compatibility-declaration refusal, and codec round trips exposed malformed relationship XML start tags.
changes: Count direct SpreadsheetDrawing sp, cxnSp and graphicFrame owners in the anchor object slot. Keep their descendants outside direct picture ownership and retain strict anchor order/cardinality. This also lets ordinary shape/chart siblings coexist with pictures.

Classify rich-value MIME type/subtype names using ASCII case-insensitive equality, without changing stored content types or relationship URI matching. Apply the same comparison to the rich-value refresh-types owner.

Admit root rvTypesInfo mc:Ignorable declarations after NCName and bound-prefix checks. Foreign subtrees remain outside typed direct-path ownership; malformed/unbound/foreign compatibility attributes are still refused.

Close the namespace quote in richValueRels serialization and close namespace/start tags in xfComplement/DXFComplement writers. Test public codec round trips rather than merely checking output existence.
Add six native regressions spanning XLS/XLSX/XLSB, five synthetic regressions, six newly asserted feature rows, and explicit matrix/index scope limits.

verification_scope.xlsx_drawing: Two typed objects share drawing1.xml: one direct Picture 2 PNG and a RoundRect named Rounded Rectangle 3 with CF_SHAPE_005. Picture id3, alt text, PNG SHA-256 d594d8f832d3ab38d03e0d06316d2fa5e401217e50e21e01814e593d752da3e8, complete A12:B17/F16:H20 markers and EMU offsets, and oneCell/twoCell behavior are exact. Zero content parts is an absence assertion, not qualification of the contentPart feature.
verification_scope.rich_values: Exactly four native richData parts are recognized. Data references structure0 with values [0,5]; _localImage keys are _rvRel:LocalImageIdentifier and CalcOrigin, both integer. The typed richValueRels id and internal image relationship are rId1 and resolve image1.png with the known hash. The refresh view retains the original rdRichValueTypes XML and reports zero types. Data, structures and relationship codecs round-trip; opaque types XML remains byte-identical. Cell-to-metadata binding and rich-value evaluation are not established.
verification_scope.svg: The DrawingSVG_013 worksheet retains exact vector hash 91bdc6ffe9ddcd4ddda5c1e4872f0003b6b0864a0523c19945a4917da6858a95 and PNG fallback hash 97fefe9283fc468417bf2b339b48197711947bd05cc835e40a31088b4e1e7990, explicit alt text and A1:D9 marker geometry. Direct source scan and worksheet owner agree. An explicit detach/attach changes only the vector label, survives temporary save/reopen, preserves raster/geometry/alt text and every unrelated member including all seventeen charts, and durably inverts to the exact native archive. attach_svg alone intentionally refuses an already attached owner.
verification_scope.xls: Native OfficeArt exposes exactly picture1025 and AutoShape1026 with CF_SHAPE_005, A12:B17/F16:H20 cell endpoints, no fabricated groups, and MoveWithoutResize/MoveAndResize behavior. This checks drawing projection, not payload resolution or full OfficeArt geometry.
verification_scope.xlsb: Eager drawing admission is explicit through drawings_parsed. Two anchors, one resolved PNG with exact hash/name/alt text/rId1, no charts, and one named RoundRect with CF_SHAPE_005 are checked. This is floating-picture evidence, not typed in-cell rich data or SVG lifecycle.
verification_scope.guards: Synthetic tests cover each non-picture object in all three anchor forms and both namespace dialects with neighbor picture isolation, malformed order/cardinality, case-folded MIME classification without accepting altered profiles, escaped relationship IDs and opaque style-complement content, and root Ignorable prefix resolution without foreign-owner promotion.
verification_scope.limitations: Original fixtures remain untouched. No Office application reopen, rendering, image re-encoding, formula evaluation, service refresh, external access or macro/control activation occurred. Legacy SourceBackedWorkbook lacks this picture method; the source assertion exercises SourceDrawing directly.
